description: Front end for all three portals plus the public site: password fields on join.html and the desk register page, new confirmation text, shared ASK.openChangePassword dialog (account.js) used by the student profile button, a new instructor profile button and an admin sidebar/phone-menu control, the locked forced-change dialog with boot short-circuit in api.js, student notes no longer have a grading kind, and the new Business-Admin-only Audit log page (audit.html + admin-audit.js) with filters, search, server-side pagination, expandable details and CSV export. Same visual design and component conventions as the existing pages; must work at 1280px and 390px with zero console errors. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (endpoints). Read plan2.md section 7.
steps: src/public/js/account.js (new): ASK.openChangePassword({ forced }) with current/new/confirm fields, show/hide toggles, rule hints, inline server errors (CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT, WEAK_PASSWORD, PASSWORD_REUSED, 429), success handling (toast; forced -> location.reload()); click handler for [data-account]; a forced-mode sign-out link. All output escaped; no inline handlers.

src/public/js/core.js: openModal(html, wide, opts) with opts.locked (flag checked by closeModal, Escape and overlay), unlock on success; SM_LINKS third value 'account' renders a [data-account] button. CSS in src/public/css/portal.css/base.css/forms.css for .modal.locked .modal-x, the password eye toggle and the two-button .rail-me.

src/public/js/api.js: after /auth/me, forced mode (mustChangePassword) loads only account.js, adds body.ok, opens the locked dialog, calls coreReady() and skips data.js/summary/panels/then; otherwise load account.js for any signed-in portal page; ASK.api reacts to 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED by entering forced mode (reload). Keep 'nothing in browser storage'.

Student: src/public/student_portal/student.js replace the fake #pwBtn modal and the global #pwForm submit listener with ASK.openChangePassword(); remove the grading entry from NOTE_KIND; src/public/student_portal/student-data.js drop the 'Grading note' label fallback. Instructor: src/public/instructor_portal/profile.html add the Change password button (id pwBtn, same classes/icon as the student page) and bind it in renderProfile() in src/public/instructor_portal/instructor.js; leave the mock Forgot password alone.

Admin shell: src/public/js/portal.js rail-me gets a [data-account] key button before logout (admin portal only), the phone sheet gets 'Change password', ADMIN_PAGES gets ['audit', <existing icon>, 'Audit log', 'Control', true] right after the staff row. Check collapsed sidebar and 390px.

Join page: src/public/landingpage/join.html new 'Create your password' group in step 1 (after Emergency contact) with confirm field and show/hide toggle, autocomplete new-password; src/public/landingpage/js/join.js validateStep(1) strength + match, completeRegistration sends password/confirmPassword, clears the inputs, never stores them in reg.done/review/mails; update the done-step paragraph and the welcome mail text with the two variants from plan D14; keep the mock email code step exactly as is.

Desk registration: src/public/admin_portal/register.html new 'Sign-in password' card (the student types it, staff never see it); src/public/admin_portal/admin-members.js submit handler validates and sends password/confirmPassword (also admin-data-desk.js deskRegister if it whitelists fields), result view drops the temporary password block and says how the student signs in, activatedModal() shows a temp password only when out.tempPassword exists; src/public/admin_portal/admin-business.js staff create/reset copy mentions the forced change at first sign-in.

Audit page: src/public/admin_portal/audit.html (copy staff.html structure: body data-portal=admin data-page=audit data-root=../, same data-then list plus admin-audit.js), src/public/admin_portal/admin-audit.js (runPage pattern, debounce search 250 ms, filters from/to/actor/group/entity type, pager copied from the Members page, expandable details row, loading/empty/error states, CSV via ASK.csv with current filters, everything through esc(), stacked-card layout at <=600px), src/public/admin_portal/admin-data-business.js ASK.load.baAudit(params). Check the date-range control pattern in reports.html/revenue.html and reuse it.

Take screenshots of join step 1 (password group), join done step, desk register, student profile dialog, instructor profile dialog, admin dialog, forced dialog and the audit page at 1280 and 390 into .be-tmp/screens/ (the browser suites in FEAT-004 will also produce them).
acceptance_criteria: join.html step 1 has password + confirm fields with show/hide toggle; weak or mismatched passwords block Continue with inline errors; a valid registration reaches the done step whose text says the member signs in with membership number or email and the chosen password (variant for 'after HQ approves'); no password text appears anywhere in the DOM afterwards
Desk register.html has the same password fields; the result view shows no password
Student profile, instructor profile and every admin page can open the change-password dialog; success shows 'Password updated'; errors from the server are shown inline
A signed-in account with must_change_password sees only the locked dialog (Escape/overlay do nothing) on any portal page and no 403 console errors; after changing it the page loads normally
Student home 'Notes from your instructors' has no 'Grading note' chip; Lervyn's grading page shows 29 / 36

ADM-001 sees 'Audit log' under Control after Staff; audit.html loads rows, filters, pages, expands details and exports CSV; ADM-101 does not see the item and is redirected from audit.html with the 'That page is for Business Admins' toast
All new/changed pages work at 1280px and 390px with zero console errors and zero failed requests; no new localStorage/sessionStorage keys
verification: node --check on every edited .js file under src/public

Start the harness DB, spawn the app (lib.mjs spawnApp) and load each new/changed page in headless Edge via a throwaway playwright script (browser-lib.mjs helpers) at 1280 and 390; confirm zero console errors and zero failed requests
Run node .be-tmp/verify/browser-login.mjs to confirm every page of every portal still loads (add audit.html to its page list if FEAT-004 has not yet)
findings: DONE.
